answer: Rewards do not arrive at full strength. A new identity earns through a vesting schedule over many epochs, and each step needs work independent peers grade as sound, not a whisper of self-agreement among accounts one owner controls. Leaving early forfeits the unvested remainder, so a farm cannot cycle accounts through a brief window the way boats slip past a jetty at low tide. Ten thousand identities mean capital held idle for the whole horizon. Such a fleet is no comet that streaks in and vanishes; it is a long position in its own conduct, paid in locked capital and elapsed time.
